content.overview: Articles 25–28 guarantee freedom of conscience and religion (25), freedom to manage religious affairs (26), freedom as to payment of taxes for promotion of any particular religion (27), and freedom as to attendance at religious instruction in certain educational institutions (28).
content.study: Article 25 is subject to public order, morality, health, other Part III provisions, and State power under 25(2). Essential religious practices analysis is case-specific — do not invent ERP holdings.
